Pull request events, including drafts, pushes to `develop` or `main`, and
manual dispatch run a Python 3.12/3.13 matrix that checks the package-version
contract, builds the distribution, and verifies editable-source and wheel
imports. The Python 3.12 offline job runs the full
public non-native test suite, strict Pyright on the three configured modules,
and Ruff F on tracked Python files. A separate Python 3.12 `docs-smoke` job
runs current source examples through file-only preparation with the pinned
public PDK. The required job fails unless all three jobs succeed. CI does not
invoke AEDT or Palace native solvers or use private golden data. Pages
rendering on `develop` and `main` pushes or manual dispatch is separate and
has code execution disabled.

## Historical format readers

The selected source retains these versioned readers. The list describes
in-tree dispatch, not a promise to migrate every older artifact.

| Format family | Reachable in-tree formats | Current handling |
|---|---|---|
| Run receipts | `receipt.v1`, `receipt.v2`, `receipt.v3` | The resolver retains exact cohort and marker rules; new handoffs write V3 initial receipts. |
| Handoffs | `handoff.v1` with manifest V1; `handoff.v2` with manifest V2 | Ordinary handoffs use V1; body-first HFSS and saved-field EPR workflows use V2. |
| Runtime source provenance | `runtime-source.v1`–`v13`, `v15`–`v24` | Each recognized version binds its own declared module inventory. V14 is not accepted by the current reader; V23 remains a frozen historical inventory. |
| EPR requests | Eigenmode EPR V1–V4; saved-analysis V1–V3; embedded planar geometry V1–V2 | Legacy payload shapes retain their version-specific decoding and serialization behavior. |
| Q2D and Q3D requests | Q2D V1; Q3D V3 | Q3D input V1/V2 are not dispatched. A historical Q3D V3 result without modeling is readable only through its result path, not as a new execution request. |
| Prepared models | Preparation-only `receipt.v3` | The model-only reader requires the explicit preparation-only receipt and verifies the saved model; it does not reinterpret older completed receipts as prepared models. |
| Saved-field cohorts and EPR results | Saved-solution manifest/receipt V1 and V2; EPR result V1 and V2 | V1 saved-solution records may have no recorded AEDT version; that origin remains unknown. Current sealing writes V2. |
| Q2D matrix outputs | Combined `rlgc_matrix.csv` | Older separate CG/RL and normalized matrix files are not decoded; their presence in a Q2D run is rejected. |

External artifact owners and consumers are `UNKNOWN`. The in-tree inventory does
not establish that external archives are unused. No additional reader is retired
by this work. Retirement requires identifying the affected artifacts and
consumers, providing an agreed migration or retention path, and an explicit
scope decision; age alone is not a retirement condition.
